title: First Session: a Tutor Classroom Simulator
niche: Tutor training and teacher education (small-group math tutoring moves, wait time, reading student cues)
audience: New tutors (college students, career changers, paraprofessionals), teacher candidates, and tutoring site coordinators who coach them
summary: Run a fictional 30-minute small-group math tutoring session with three simulated students. Read their body language, choose tutoring moves at eight decision points, practice real wait time, then review a replay that shows how each student's understanding, engagement and confidence changed. Two student mixes; transparent authored rules, no AI.
contentNotes: Simulated students are fictional and constructed for teaching purposes; one student expresses discouragement about math ("I'm bad at math").

poster.alt: Three simulated middle-school students seated at a wooden tutoring table with worksheets, a whiteboard showing a linear equation behind them, seen from the tutor's seat
